goal: 90% real domestic search completeness with bounded operational load
root_causes: Native publisher listings contained 19-50 article links but omitted machine-readable <time datetime>; native date boundary verification stays PARTIAL.
Initial implementation verified only first 3 items, dropped remaining valid listing URLs, and reran every source fallback.
Second implementation collects up to 12 potentially relevant links/source, verifies one original/source and keeps unverified candidates for editorial gate.
Earlier reviewed morning articles have scrolled beyond the latest 12/first page at later collection time; reviewed 26-case comparison is not a valid independent full-news recall denominator.
WEB six RSS index queries cannot certify nine individual publisher PASS/PASS_ZERO outcomes; 21/23 publisher gate is structurally unreachable without alternative independent evidence.
quality_notes: 46 logical calls != exact HTTP requests; Google token resolution may make multiple HTTP calls.
100% query-route accessibility does NOT mean 100% article coverage.
Source verification 0/23 is reported strictly; no fake PASS_ZERO.
154 discoveries include many unverified headlines, not finished publish-ready briefing articles.
Full publishing validation also requires editorial article previews, high-priority fact checks and other sections.
Latest run sample recovery 8/26 is a time-sensitive diagnostic, not a full article recall measurement.
Latest 334 raw candidates are not editorial items; only 12 original-verified, so stage4 queue capped at 40 after test.
next_required: Domestic discovery is operationally responding (20/20 route/axis), but 90% verified publisher coverage and editorial article recovery remain unproven. Improve dated pagination / targeted morning-window discovery and independent coverage evidence before moving to global/patent or publishing.
